user.title: Connect Meteonomiqs
user.description: Enter at least one API key. Up to 4 keys will be rotated round-robin.

error.required: At least one API key is required.

init.title: Automatic weather updates
init.description: Select up to four full-hour times (HH:00). The API request starts 5 minutes earlier, and sensor values publish at the hour. Empty slots disable fetching. Respect API quotas; manual updates remain available.

error.invalid_time: Use a full hour in HH:00 format.
